name: Goat birria braise and consommé (batch; costed per gram of cooked meat)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
shelf_life_note: 3 days at ≤ 5 °C (ASSUMPTION; set by a professional)
method: Toast chiles briefly (do not scorch), soak in hot water 20 min, blend with garlic, onion, vinegar, oregano and ground whole spices to a smooth adobo.
Sear goat in batches; coat with adobo (optionally fry the paste until the oil separates: Session 5 arm B), add water and bay; cover/seal.

Braise low (a chef sets the temperature and time; Session 5 records them) until tender but fibrous; target about 1,000 g cooked boneless meat and about 1,250 ml consommé from the batch (ASSUMPTION: measure the real yield).
Skim the surface fat into a container (used to dip and griddle the tortillas); strain and season the consommé; shred or pull the meat, keeping some fibre so it reads as goat.

sauce_spec.acid: vinegar in adobo + lime at service
sauce_spec.salt: about 1.2% of goat weight, adjusted after braise
sauce_spec.use: 2 tacos + small cup of consommé per portion (about 100 g meat + 90 ml consommé)

food_safety: Large-batch braise is the highest food-safety risk in the Core 5: cooling and reheating must follow a written process set by a food-safety professional (US Food Code orientation: cool 57 °C → 21 °C within 2 h and → 5 °C within 4 more hours; reheat to 74 °C within 2 h; hot-hold at or above 57 °C).
Use goat/chicken/vegetable stock only (D-54): no beef or pork stock, bones or lard. No halal claim.
Skimmed fat sets on cooling: keep separate, label, use within the written shelf life.
evidence: food/sessions/S5-goat-birria.md (T5 baseline: ~600 g bone-in goat per arm, adobo, braise, 2 tacos + consommé)
estimates_label: All quantities, yields and shelf-life values are preliminary estimates until tested by a person in a kitchen.
costing_basis: Cost basis = about 1,000 g cooked boneless meat per batch (ASSUMPTION: ~42% of the 2,400 g bone-in goat). The consommé (about 1,250 ml) is a by-product allocated at zero cost, so each portion (100 g meat + 90 ml consommé) carries the full goat cost.
lifecycle: RETIRED (D-88): removed from the active menu and the candidate development pool by founder decision 2026-10-23. Historical record preserved. Do not reintroduce without founder approval.
